personal.name: Aryaman Pradhan
personal.title: AI Strategist
personal.headline: If you do it every week, it shouldn't need you.
personal.subheadline: I write Python that takes over the repeating parts of a business — the research, the replies, the onboarding, the publishing — and hands the judgment calls back to a human.
personal.tagline: I build systems in Python that replace the manual work your team repeats every week — research, replies, onboarding, publishing — so they can focus on the decisions that actually need a human.
personal.bio: I work with marketing and creative agencies to turn their recurring operational work into software that runs itself. The builds are Python against real APIs — Notion, Gmail, Slack, Sheets — with language models handling the parts that need judgment, and human approval gates on anything that reaches a customer. No no-code platforms, no per-run billing, no vendor lock-in.

services.desc: Research, drafting, and publishing pipelines with human approval gates so nothing ships unreviewed.

principles: Every AI component ships with an eval harness — structural checks and scored rubrics — so output quality is measured, not assumed.
Human approval gates on anything customer-facing. The model drafts; a person decides what goes out.
Every generated claim carries a source URL. If it can't be cited, it doesn't ship.
Built directly against APIs in Python — no no-code middleware, no per-run billing, no platform you don't own.
Scoped to fail visibly. A silent wrong answer is more expensive than a loud error.
One codebase per client, configured through environment — not forked, not rewritten, not wrapped in a platform.

projects.brief: Deal closed in Notion, fully provisioned client workspace. Zero manual steps.
projects.objective: Automates the first five steps of agency client onboarding: a Notion deal marked Won triggers client workspace creation, a welcome email, intake-form ingestion back into Notion, and generation of the onboarding checklist — with no manual setup in between.
outcomes: Deal-won to fully provisioned client workspace with no human touch
Built entirely on free-tier and native APIs to hold a hard budget ceiling
153+ tests covering the pipeline end to end

projects.name: Football Content Research Pipeline
projects.brief: Automated research-to-script pipeline for a football creator. Two human gates, zero hosting.
projects.objective: An automated research-to-script pipeline for a short-form football content creator. Takes a client-curated queue of football legends, researches the best chronologically-fitting stories for each with sourced references, and produces a complete script — with two human approval gates handled entirely inside Notion.
outcomes: Approval happens in Notion via checkbox — no chat bot, no always-on host, no monthly hosting bill
Every story candidate and every researched fact carries a mandatory source URL
AI drafts one complete script; the human decides how to split it into episodes
Eval harness gates the research and script agents before anything ships

projects.name: Inbound Lead Response Service
projects.brief: Webhook fires, lead enriched, Slack pings, personalized reply sent — before competitors pick up.
projects.objective: A resellable lead-response service for small businesses. A web-form webhook fires, the lead's site is scraped for context, the team gets a Slack alert, and the lead gets a personalized reply by email — before a competitor answers.
outcomes: Every client-specific value lives in env — nothing hardcoded, so a new install is a config change
Background worker handles enrichment so the webhook always returns fast
Falls back to templates when no LLM is configured — the service never hard-depends on one

projects.name: Prospect Research & Outreach Pipeline

Copy rules enforced programmatically — length, formatting, and pitch structure
Runs as my own outreach engine, not a demo
